description: This file defines a controller class for managing stock status in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, viewing, editing, saving, and deleting stock status entries, handling request parameters, generating URLs, and rendering views.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing stock status settings in the admin area, including listing, editing, saving, and deleting stock status entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the stock status list page, sets up necessary data and renders the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to render the stock status list as a response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of stock statuses, including pagination, sorting, and links, then returns the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a stock status, loading data if editing an existing entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a stock status entry, performing validation, and responding with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected stock status entries if permitted and if no products are associated with them, responding with JSON.
